background_rationale: Rose at Energy Transfer through business development, commercial and operating roles, serving as president and COO of its operating partnership and later group COO and chief commercial officer.

notable.summary: McCrea notified Energy Transfer that he intends to retire as co-CEO on or before Dec. 31, 2026, citing personal objectives and more time with family, and will remain on the board afterward.
Energy Transfer announced a fully subscribed expansion of its Nederland, Texas, export terminal adding 240,000 barrels per day of ethane export capacity, with phased startup from 2028.
Energy Transfer, Sunoco, SunocoCorp and USA Compression changed their state of formation from Delaware to Texas, effective July 6, 2026.
Energy Transfer announced it would move its common unit listing from the NYSE to the Texas Stock Exchange, effective Oct. 5, 2026.

personal_story.hook: Mackie McCrea joined Energy Transfer's business in 1997 and became its co-CEO 24 years later.
personal_story.summary: Little about McCrea's early life is public. He joined La Grange Acquisition, Energy Transfer's main operating subsidiary, in 1997 as senior vice president of business development and producer services, and became its president in 2005. He went on to lead the midstream business, served as president and COO of the operating partnership from 2008 to 2015, and later as group COO and chief commercial officer. Named co-CEO in January 2021, he announced in June 2026 that he would retire by the end of the year to pursue personal objectives and spend more time with his family.
